reasoning: On the season so far the Cavaliers are the stronger team; with home court the Cavaliers start about 1 points better, in a game of about 234 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Mavericks.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Mavericks win 52 times in 100; most games like this end between 208 and 256 total points.
